title: Branch Totals
statement:
A tree has `n` nodes numbered `1..n`, and node `1` is the root. Node `i` holds the value `a_i`. The subtree of a node is the node itself and all of its descendants. You get `q` queries; query `j` names a node and asks for the sum of the values in its subtree.

To keep the output short, print the sum of the answers to all queries.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `q`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`. The third line contains the parent of each node `2..n` (it is absent when `n = 1`). Then `q` lines follow, each with one node number.

## Output
Print the sum of the `q` answers.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, q <= 8000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
